messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposal for the chat endpoint shape.
Maya (PM): Problem: customers want a single, stable chat API that is 'messages-first' but many current clients still send a single prompt string. We need a clear dual-mode plan, launch gates, and migration ergonomics. Input: enterprise beta asks for role enforcement and structured output hooks for tool-calling.
Ethan (Eng): +1 on messages-first default. Implementation note: runtime already supports messages arrays; biggest work is API contract, SDK changes, and backwards compat shim for prompt.
Rina (ML): Important: require system role semantics preserved. Also we should validate role types server-side (system/user/assistant) and reject unknown roles to avoid prompt injection surprises.
Jia (DevEx): From SDK perspective: offer convenience helpers: from_prompt(prompt) -> messages and messages.to_prompt() (with warning). Keep prompt-compat mode behind a header X-RI-compat or param for rollout.
Tom (Eng-Platform): Ops impacts: telemetry fields need to record whether request used prompt-compat vs messages-native, model variant used, and token delta so we can correlate cost regressions during rollout. Also need feature flag for canary rollout per org.
Olivia (CS): Several customers (legal-search, customer-support SaaS) asked for minimal payloads — they want to send a single string from mobile without reworking clients. They prefer an official shim rather than building on top.
Ethan (Eng): Proposal: API accepts either:
```
// messages-native
{ 'messages': [ { 'role':'system','content':'You are X.' }, { 'role':'user','content':'Hi' } ] }
// prompt-compat (deprecated opt-in)
{ 'prompt': 'You are X.\nUser: Hi' }
```
Ethan (Eng): Server rules: 1) messages present -> treat as canonical. 2) prompt present and messages missing -> translate to messages via a deterministic canonicalizer (system role insertion if provided via header). 3) both present -> reject (avoid ambiguity).
Rina (ML): For model-side tool/function calling we should preserve the assistant role concept: functions invoked by assistant messages still map to the same function-calling contract. No change in function payload, but validator must ensure assistant messages are not used to set system-level instructions.
Jia (DevEx): Docs/SDK: include migration snippet and a quick compatibility util. Example: messages.from_prompt('...') and note that conversion can change token counts. Add deprecation timeline: opt-in prompt-compat for 6 months, then mandatory messages-only unless customer requests extended support.
Maya (PM): Launch gates (proposed):
- API spec finalized and SDKs (js/py) implement helpers.
- Telemetry: flags for compat mode, per-org rollout capability.
- Beta customers (3) verify no behavioral regressions.
- E2E tests + perf: no >10% increase in p95 latency vs today.
- Security review: role enforcement and audit logs in place.
Tom (Eng-Platform): Rollout plan: feature-flagged on platform, start with internal orgs -> partner customers -> wide. Add automatic fallback to older model variant on errors for first 2 weeks.
Olivia (CS): I'll line up beta customers and collect acceptance tests. Also request an administrative opt-out for customers that must keep prompt-compat beyond the 6 months.
Ethan (Eng): Prioritization: work split across two sprints: sprint A: API + validator + SDK helpers; sprint B: telemetry + rollout infra + deprecation notices. Estimate: 6 eng-weeks + 2 SE for SDKs.
Rina (ML): One more ask: add an explicit field for structured-output preference (e.g., 'response_format': 'json_schema') so evals and quality monitoring can track regression on structured outputs.
Maya (PM): Agreed — add as optional param. Will surface as a launch bleed: initial supported set = ['text','json_schema'].
Jia (DevEx): Docs task list: migration guide, example conversions, FAQ about token differences, sample payloads for function calling + structured output.
Maya (PM): Next steps: Ethan to draft API spec PR by EOD Friday, Jia to prototype SDK helpers, Tom to wire telemetry flag, Olivia to nominate 2 customers for beta. We'll reconvene Thu morning for signoff.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: api-spec-draft -> review (no ops changes)"
